intro: Milly's Harvest consists of crates and buckets of freshly picked grapes gathered by Milly Osworth in the Northshire Vineyards. When Defias bandits overran the fields, the harvest was abandoned, leaving the fruit at risk of being stolen by thieves or crushed beneath the boots of abbey guards.

p: The fertile soil of the Northshire Valley produces grapes vital for local vintners and the abbey community. When harvesting season arrived, Milly Osworth worked the vines to collect the fresh fruit into storage buckets. Her work was violently interrupted when armed brigands bearing red masks pushed into the vineyards, forcing her to flee back to the abbey grounds with her crop left scattered between the rows.

Though Stormwind guards watch the valley entrance, manpower shortages have left Northshire vulnerable. While the garrison promised to drive the Defias out, Milly feared that any drawn-out skirmish between armored guards and ruthless thieves would result in the complete destruction of her work. Retrieving the crates before they are trampled underfoot or carried off as provisions ensures that one of Northshire's few peaceful harvests is not lost.
